notes: Stage 1: 5% target, 5% daily, 10% total loss; Stage 2: 6% target, 5% daily, 8% total loss; Trader stage: 5% daily, 8% total. Minimum 5 trading days in each stage (a day with at least one opened position). maxLossPct stores the Stage 1 value.
Market Crypto + TradFi: perpetual futures on 160+ crypto pairs plus tokenised indices, metals and energy, trading 24/7 including weekends.

Prices are the one-time fees shown on the hashhedge.com homepage selector on 2026-10-19 from a US IP; Hash Hedge publishes one USDT/USDC price list (no regional switcher seen). Each card also shows '+5% Cashback' (HH Coins, non-withdrawable promotional credit).

Fees are non-refundable except if Hash Hedge cancels a Challenge before it starts or a duplicate payment is reported within 7 days (Terms 10.1/10.6, last updated 8 Oct 2026); refundable=false records that, not a pass refund.
Profit share 80%; 90% with the paid '+10% Profit Split' checkout add-on. Add-on prices 'scale with your account size' and are shown only in the logged-in checkout; not captured.

Payouts: after a 14-day period, account in profit, all positions closed; min $100, max $10,000 per account per 14 days; USDT on ERC-20, TRC-20, BEP-20, Arbitrum, Optimism, Solana. Commercial Terms: the trader picks a payout day 14-60 calendar days from the first trade of the cycle. Payout obligations sit with FinSmart Solution Ltd (Seychelles, 246832).
72-hour guarantee is official: Commercial Terms section 3 pays 3x a valid, complete request not paid within 72 hours, excluding requests under Hold, investigation or re-verification.

Leverage capped at 1:5. EAs: Terms 12.2 bars using 'automated tools, bots, scripts, APIs, or software to access, interact with, manipulate, or interfere with the Platform'; the platform is Hash Hedge's own web terminal (no MT4/MT5). Arbitrage, manipulation and Prohibited Hedging across accounts (Terms 11) are banned; hedging inside one account is allowed.
No consistency rule was found in the user guide, Terms or Commercial Terms read on 2026-10-19; not confirmed absent.

Drawdown basis unresolved: the guide measures limits 'against your account size' ($25K: max total loss $2,500), while the homepage labels Max Overall Drawdown 'Peak-to-trough loss limit across the full challenge'. drawdownType left null.

No KYC at purchase ('the account is instant and there's no KYC'); identity verification is required before a Live Account and re-verification can be required before a payout (Commercial Terms 2-3, Terms 6.5).
No independent payout verification. Payout certificates on the homepage are the firm's own claims.
